title: Kinolis
description: An ancient emporion on the southern coast of the Black Sea, mentioned in multiple ancient sources. It is probably to be identified with the subsequent site of "Ginolu Kalesi", a now-ruined 9th/10th century CE castle in the modern municipal territory of Çatalzeytin in Turkey's Kastamonu Province.
